item.title: Israel looking for 'solutions' to open Christian sites after barring church leader on Palm Sunday due to war
item.summary: Jerusalem's Church of the Holy Sepulchre closed on Palm Sunday under Israeli wartime rules, drawing rebukes from the Catholic Church and Italy.

item.title: Jet fuel spikes as airlines warn supplies could run dry within weeks
item.summary: U.S. jet fuel prices jumped from $2.17 to $4.57 per gallon in weeks, prompting airline cuts and raising concerns over shortages and higher fares.

item.title: Kurt Russell reflects on humble upbringing, says he once lived in an attic in LA
item.summary: Kurt Russell recalls living in an attic in East LA as a child after his father left baseball to pursue acting, reflecting on his humble beginnings.

item.title: Tyrell Fortune wins UFC debut after score error reversal, years after being pronounced dead
item.summary: UFC heavyweight Tyrell Fortune accepted a fight on two weeks' notice and won by unanimous decision, only to leave the octagon after the cage announcer misread the scores.

item.title: FBI email hack shows why you must lock down your tech
item.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel's personal email was hacked, with Iran's Handala Hack Team claiming responsibility. No classified data was breached, the FBI says.

item.title: Scholars say forced abortions on minors using 'physical restraint' may be justified as a last resort
item.summary: University of British Columbia scholars argued in a University of Chicago Journal paper that pregnant minors' caregivers should terminate their pregnancies, using restraint if needed.

item.title: Bond girl Ursula Andress claims she was ‘deliberately chosen’ as victim in brazen theft of $23M fortune
item.summary: Italian authorities seized artwork and assets worth $23 million allegedly stolen from Bond girl Ursula Andress by her longtime financial advisor.

item.title: Meet Alabama’s Chase Utley, the teen who mirrors the Phillies legend in striking ways
item.summary: A young Alabama baseball player named Chase Utley shares his name, position and handedness with the Philadelphia Phillies legend — and they plan to meet soon.

item.title: Wake-up call: Landmark social media ruling exposes addictive algorithms as teen survey highlights dangers
item.summary: A Colorado teen surveyed over 1,000 girls and found strong links social media use and anxiety, depression and sleep deprivation in young girls.

item.title: Sen Mazie Hirono trolled for admitting Trump not 'a king,' and 'never has been'
item.summary: Sen. Mazie Hirono's No Kings post backfired as Republicans like Chip Roy and Mike Lee mocked her for seemingly undermining the anti-Trump rallies.
